purpose: Evaluate milestone-level dependencies with deterministic software-engineering micro cases.

baseline_policy.sequential: Completion-time handoff may trigger an explicit producer revision and consumer rework.
baseline_policy.naive_parallel: One-shot no-communication negative control; it has no recovery and is not a performance-equivalent baseline.
baseline_policy.live_handoff: In-flight plan-bound READY/FEEDBACK/UPDATE delivery with version validation.

frozen_cases.description: A publishes an API contract before completing implementation; B migrates the caller from that contract.
success_criteria: live consumer starts after READY and before producer completion
naive parallel records the uncoordinated contract mismatch

frozen_cases.description: A publishes a config schema; B discovers a legacy alias constraint that changes A's remaining work.
success_criteria: sequential completes through late feedback, producer revision, and consumer rework
naive parallel remains an explicitly labeled no-recovery negative control
live consumer starts before producer completion
consumer publishes blocking FEEDBACK for version 1
producer consumes FEEDBACK at a named safe boundary
producer changes its candidate and publishes UPDATE version 2

frozen_cases.description: B requires A's completed generated constant and must not start early.
success_criteria: consumer starts at or after producer completion

required_path: stale model response discard and REPLAN
